```{r, fig.height=7,fig.width=8}
df = simulate_data_p(1000, sigma_e = -1.5, sigma_k = -2, sigma_m = -1, bias = 0, seed = 1997)

df[1,]
df %>% ggplot(aes(x = X*D, y = a_gauss))+geom_point()+geom_smooth(method = glm, method.args= list(family="binomial"))

df %>% ggplot(aes(x = X*D, y = C, col = as.factor(ACC)))+geom_point()+geom_smooth()
df %>% ggplot(aes(x = X*D, y = C, col = as.factor(a_gauss)))+geom_point()+geom_smooth()


psy = df %>% mutate(XD = X*D) %>% mutate(XD = cut(XD,10)) %>% group_by(XD) %>% summarize(mean = mean(a_gauss))
conf = df %>% mutate(XD = X*D)%>% mutate(XD = cut(XD,10)) %>% group_by(XD,a_gauss) %>% summarize(mean = mean(c_mu))

data.frame() %>% ggplot()+
  geom_point(data = psy, aes(x = XD, y = mean), col = "black")+
  geom_point(data = conf, aes(XD, y = mean, col = as.factor(a_gauss)))


psy = df %>% mutate(XD = X*D) %>% mutate(XD = cut(XD,10)) %>% group_by(XD) %>% summarize(mean = mean(a_gauss))
conf = df %>% mutate(XD = X*D)%>% mutate(XD = cut(XD,10)) %>% group_by(XD,ACC) %>% summarize(mean = mean(c_mu))

data.frame() %>% ggplot()+
  geom_point(data = psy, aes(x = XD, y = mean), col = "black")+
  geom_point(data = conf, aes(XD, y = mean, col = as.factor(ACC)))
```

```{r}

sigma_e = -1
sigma_k = -3
sigma_m = -1
bias = 0

breaks <- seq(-1, 1, by = 0.05)
midpoints <- breaks[-length(breaks)] + 0.1

df_mech = simulate_data_p(500000, sigma_e = sigma_e, sigma_k = sigma_k, sigma_m = sigma_m, bias = bias, seed = 1) %>% 
    mutate(XD = X * D,
    bin = cut(XD, breaks = breaks, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE),
    XD = (breaks[bin] + breaks[bin + 1]) / 2)
  

df_heu = simulate_data_margin(5000, sigma_e = sigma_e, sigma_k = sigma_k, sigma_m = sigma_m, bias = bias, seed = 1) %>% mutate(XD = X*D)

data.frame() %>% ggplot()+
  geom_pointrange(data = df_mech %>% 
                    mutate(ACC = as.factor(ACC))%>% 
                    group_by(XD, ACC) %>% 
                    summarize(mean = mean(c_mu), 
                              se = sd(c_mu)/sqrt(n())),
                  aes(x = XD,y = mean,ymin = mean-2*se, ymax = mean+2*se, fill = ACC), shape = 21, col = "black")+
  geom_pointrange(data = df_mech %>% 
                    group_by(XD, ) %>% 
                    summarize(k = sum(a_gauss),
                              n = n(),
                              prop = k / n,
                              a_post = k + 1,
                              b_post = (n - k) + 1,
                              lower = qbeta(0.025, a_post, b_post),
                              upper = qbeta(0.975, a_post, b_post)),
                  aes(x = XD,y = prop,ymin = lower, ymax = upper), shape = 21, col = "black",fill = "black")+
  geom_line(data = df_heu %>% mutate(ACC = as.factor(ACC)), aes(x = XD,y = c_mu, col = ACC), linewidth = 2, alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_line(data = df_heu, aes(x = XD,y = p_gauss), linewidth = 2, alpha = 0.5, col = "black")+
  theme_classic()+
  labs(x = "Stimulus Intensity")+
  theme(legend.position = "top")
  


```

```{r, fig.height=12,fig.width=8}

fit = function(){
  
  qq = rnorm(1,1,1)
  
  df = simulate_data(n = 300)

  mod = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Stanmodels","Heurestic models","Simulations","old.stan"))
  
  datastan = list(a = df$a_gauss,
                  ACC = df$ACC,
                  C = df$C,
                  # rts = df$rts,
                  N = nrow(df),
                  XD = df$X * df$D,
                  X = df$X)
  
  
  fit = mod$sample(data = datastan,
                   iter_warmup = 500,
                   refresh = 0,
                   iter_sampling = 500,
             parallel_chains = 4)
  
  div = data.frame(fit$diagnostic_summary())%>% mutate(sim = qq,
                                                        time = fit$time()$total)
  
  estimated = fit$summary("gm") %>% mutate(variable = c("alpha","beta","confprec","metauncor","metauninc","metabias"
                                            )) %>% mutate(div = max(div$num_divergent))
  
  loo = fit$loo()
  
  pareto_o7 = sum(loo$diagnostics$pareto_k > 0.7)
  
  
  modnew = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Stanmodels","Heurestic models","Simulations","final_heu.stan"))

  datastan = list(a = df$a_gauss,
                ACC = df$ACC,
                C = df$C,
                N = nrow(df),
                XD = df$X * df$D,
                X = df$X)

    

  fita = modnew$sample(data = datastan,
                   iter_warmup = 500,
                   refresh = 0,
                   iter_sampling = 500,
             parallel_chains = 4)
  
  diva = data.frame(fita$diagnostic_summary())%>% mutate(sim = qq,
                                                        time = fit$time()$total)
  
  estimateda = fita$summary("gm") %>% mutate(variable = c("beta","sigma_e","sigma_k","sigma_m","confprec"
                                            )) %>% mutate(div = max(diva$num_divergent))
  
  looa = fita$loo()
  
  pareto_o7a = sum(looa$diagnostics$pareto_k > 0.7)
  
  loo_comparison = data.frame(loo::loo_compare(list(old = loo, action = looa))) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("model") %>% 
    arrange(model) %>% 
    mutate(pareto_k = c(pareto_o7a,pareto_o7))
  
  additional = fita$summary(c("sigma1","sigma2"))%>% 
    mutate(div = max(diva$num_divergent))
  
  
  simulated = data.frame(c0 = unique(df$c0),
                         c1 = unique(df$c1),
                         sigma_k = unique(df$sigma_k),
                         sigma_e =unique(df$sigma_e),
                         sigma_m =unique(df$sigma_m),
                         bias = unique(df$bias),
                         conf_prec =unique(df$conf_prec)) %>% mutate(sim_n = qq)
  
  data = df %>% mutate(conf_bin = cut(C,4),
                      stimulus  = as.factor(D),
                      participant = 1,
                      rating = as.numeric(as.factor(conf_bin)),
                      correct = ACC) %>% drop_na()


  
  mratio = fitMetaDprime(data)
  
    
  result = list(simulated = simulated %>% mutate(sim_n = qq),
                estimated = estimated%>% mutate(sim_n = qq, model = "old"),
                estimateda = estimateda%>% mutate(sim_n = qq, model = "action"),
                additional = additional%>% mutate(sim_n = qq),
                loo = loo_comparison %>% mutate(sim_n = qq),
                data = df%>% mutate(sim_n = qq),
                div = div,
                diva = diva,
                mratio = mratio %>% mutate(sim_n = qq))
  
  return(result)
}

qq = fit()
2+2

library(furrr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyverse)

plan(multisession, workers = 10)  # Windows-friendly

safe_function <- possibly(fit, otherwise = "Error")

# Run 20 times in parallel
results_list <- future_map(1:10000, ~ safe_function(), .progress = T)

saveRDS(results_list,here::here("Simulations","Heurestic","Saved models","10000sim_300trials_finalHeu.RData"))

results_list = results_list[-which(results_list == "Error")]
```

```{r}
inner_join(
  map_dfr(results_list,1), 
  map_dfr(results_list,3) %>% 
    filter(rhat < 1.03 & ess_bulk > 400, ess_tail > 400) %>% 
    select(mean,variable,sim_n,div) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = "variable",values_from = c("mean")) %>% 
    unnest() %>% drop_na() %>% rename_with(~ paste0("esti_", .x)) %>% 
    mutate(sim_n = esti_sim_n)
) %>% 
    # filter(div == 0 & 1/sqrt(sigma_k^2+sigma_e^2) < 20) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = esti_sigma_e, y = sigma_e))+geom_point(alpha = 0.1)+geom_abline()+
  ggtitle("action model")

inner_join(
  map_dfr(results_list,1), 
  map_dfr(results_list,2) %>% 
    filter(rhat < 1.03 & ess_bulk > 400, ess_tail > 400) %>% 
    select(mean,variable,sim_n,div) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = "variable",values_from = "mean") %>% 
    unnest()
) %>% 
    # filter(div == 0 &  1/sqrt(sigma_k^2+sigma_e^2) < 20 & exp(beta) < 50) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = exp(beta), y = 1/sqrt(exp(sigma_k)^2+exp(sigma_e)^2)))+geom_point()+geom_abline()+
  ggtitle("old model")
```
